interpretation_cautions: Trial-level descriptive n is 40 per arm, but inferential n is 10 complete randomized rounds.
All failed trials are retained. A timing contrast excludes a round only when either compared arm lacks that timing value.
The endpoints measure local action installation and the configured probe, not Internet-wide reachability.
